description: This file is a shell script used for testing the git merge-tree command, including various test cases and setup steps.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution, runs the provided commands.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files or strings.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that a given output is empty.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests complete.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes multiple lines to a file or output for comparison.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the system clock or simulates passage of time to ensure unique timestamps in tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script, finalizing the test run.
